SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = 'QNA' AND IS_REPLY = 0 AND STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT NOTICE_NO as notice_no, TITLE as title, CONTENT as content, WRITER as writer, BOARD_TYPE as board_type, COUNT as count, IS_REPLY as is_reply, PARENT_NO as parent_no, STATUS as status, FILE_STR as file_str, ORG_FILENAME as org_filename, TO_CHAR(INDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as indate FROM BOARD WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{notice_no}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET COUNT = COUNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{notice_no}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT NOTICE_NO as notice_no, TITLE as title, WRITER as writer, COUNT as count, STATUS as status, TO_CHAR(INDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as indate FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = 'QNA' AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY NOTICE_NO DESC ) a WHERE rownum <= #{pageEnd} ) WHERE rnum >= #{pageStart}
